falsification: Repeated cross-view corroboration consolidated two of three unseen surface views, but a third relation failed because character-level anti-unification absorbed a function particle into the value boundary. The mechanism therefore learns a corroborated new surface view, not open-ended Japanese semantics, pronoun resolution, reasoning, planning, generation or general continual learning.
